meta.descriptor: the main city of the Beauce region on the Chaudière River

overview: Saint-Georges counted 32,935 residents in the 2021 Census, up 1.3 percent from 32,513 in 2016. Its 15,415 occupied dwellings spread over 199.08 square kilometres along the Chaudière River.

Manufacturing drives the city, led by the head offices of Manac and Canam, and Saint-Georges serves as the shopping and education hub for the wider Beauce. For a local business, steady but modest growth means success depends on reputation, referrals and drawing customers in from surrounding towns.
